shot.title: 主角没看见的父母反应
shot.start_end_and_action: Medium smartphone reaction view from a guest beside the west arcade, looking toward the groom's parents seated together at the edge of the same wedding courtyard. His father, now older with greying hair and a restrained dark suit, applauds gently. His mother, naturally aged from the childhood scenes and wearing a muted formal outfit, smiles while holding up a smartphone to record the couple offscreen. Keep their faces distinct from grandmother. Their eyelines point toward the established dance floor. Warm dusk light and the same table decorations link the space. One steady four-second shot with natural applause and quiet laughter; no cut back inside the shot.
